records.process_description: Enrolled master’s students select a habilitated or equivalently qualified supervisor and agree on a topic. In the semester in which the thesis is submitted the student must book the module “Masterarbeit” via the online module booking system; after the booking deadline an e‑mail requests the provisional title and supervisor and provides the upload link for the final PDF. The thesis is individually written (typically ~50–80 pages, ≈180’000–240’000 characters). It is assessed in two written reports (first reviewer = supervisor; second reviewer appointed by the study commission). Submission: three properly bound copies to Prodekanat Lehre (Büro KIR 106) plus a PDF via the provided upload link. Deadlines: FS 15 May, HS 15 November. Official guidelines and forms (supervision/assessment, declaration of independence, title page, printing specifications) are provided as PDFs on the page.
